entry.content:
# Source Title Summary Topics Link
1 CNA Hong Kong rolls out AI facial recognition across CCTV network The AI functions will be used to monitor crowds and read licence plates, as well as track criminal suspects. AI Read
2 TechAsia How one startup shrinks AI down to a single transistor By mimicking the human brain, Newmorphic is bringing powerful, low-energy AI capabilities directly to battery-powered wearables and sensors. AI Read
3 CNA South Korea to inspect glasses worn by exam candidates after AI cheating scandal South Korea adds glasses inspections, smart device monitoring and tougher penalties to protect this week’s college entrance exam from AI-assisted cheating. AI Read

AILogistics Read
5 DigiTimes SK Hynix's Trinity Fab aims to shorten suppliers' path to chip production A new open test facility inside SK Hynix's Yongin semiconductor cluster is designed to address a costly bottleneck for domestic suppliers: proving that materials, components, and equipment can perform reliably under mass-production conditions before entering a chipmaker's production line. Semiconductor Read
6 DigiTimes Qisda affiliate Ace Pillar deepens semiconductor and AI automation push, expanding into wafer regeneration and SiPh Taiwan-based industrial automation and smart manufacturing solutions provider Ace Pillar, an affiliate of Qisda Group, reported strong third-quarter 2026 results as its semiconductor, AI automation and green-energy businesses gained traction. Chairman Joshua Tzeng said the company will anchor its medium- to long-term g SemiconductorAIAutomation Read
7 DigiTimes India touts homegrown 2-micron 5-axis CNC machines as it seeks local semiconductor equipment India's electronics and IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on November 14 that the country has developed indigenous five-axis precision CNC machines with 2-micron accuracy, and called for India to build its own machinery and high-precision components for semiconductor manufacturing to reduce reliance on imports. SemiconductorElectronics Read

The post How Statistical Analysis Improved Semiconductor Manufacturing at Macronix appeared first on EE Times Asia . Semiconductor Read
10 TechAsia Info Edge backs Indian chip startup Bharat Semi’s $24m seed The funding will support product development, engineering hires, and expansion in the US and other markets. Semiconductor Read
11 TechAsia Paper, plastic, or tokens? Grab’s AI grocery bet runs into a who-pays problem Retailers’ limited margins and expensive AI token costs, however, could hamper its full implementation, analysts say. AI Read

entry.title: Asia Tech News Digest - November 10, 2026
entry.content:
# Source Title Summary Topics Link
1 DigiTimes Ericsson CEO bets on AI and in-house RAN chips as 6G, satellite competition loom Ericsson CEO Per Narvinger is betting on AI to drive the next wave of telecom equipment demand, as the Swedish vendor develops dedicated radio access network (RAN) chips, strengthens its indoor 5G business and targets opportunities in the 6G era. AISemiconductor Read
2 CNA Chipmaker Infineon forecasts strong 2027 growth on data-centre demand Chipmaker Infineon forecasts strong 2027 growth on data-centre demand Semiconductor Read
3 CNA Europe can compete in robotics and physical AI, top chipmaker CEOs say Europe can compete in robotics and physical AI, top chipmaker CEOs say SemiconductorAutomation Read
4 DigiTimes Yageo posts record October sales as China holiday weighs on Walsin's revenue Taiwanese passive component makers Yageo and Walsin Technology reported contrasting October results, with Yageo posting record monthly revenue on strong AI demand while Walsin's sales declined from September due to China's National Day holidays. Both companies recorded year-over-year revenue growth of more than 50%. AI Read
5 TechAsia This startup helps enterprises adopt AI safely Backed by local groups Dart and Aleph, Scouter helps Singapore's enterprises implement the right AI security tools ahead of new regulations. AI Read
6 DigiTimes Nvidia showcases factory AI at Seoul event; Jensen Huang's daughter absent Nvidia showcased its work with South Korean manufacturers on robot simulation, precision sanding and factory digital twins as its AI Day Seoul event opened on November 9, despite the absence of senior director Madison Huang, who canceled her planned visit to South Korea. AIAutomation Read
7 EETAsia NSING Technologies Ships 250 Million Bluetooth Chips Using Ceva IP NSING Technologies has shipped 250 million Bluetooth chips incorporating Ceva Bluetooth LE IP across consumer, automotive and industrial markets. The post NSING Technologies Ships 250 Million Bluetooth Chips Using Ceva IP appeared first on EE Times Asia . Semiconductor Read
8 TechAsia Sun Life to roll out Google Gemini AI to advisors in Asia The company said Gemini would be available within Workspace, alongside Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, and Google Meet. AI Read
9 EETAsia AI Chip Advances Put Semiconductor Materials and Packaging in Focus Rising AI chip performance demands are driving advances in materials engineering, manufacturing equipment and advanced semiconductor packaging technologies. The post AI Chip Advances Put Semiconductor Materials and Packaging in Focus appeared first on EE Times Asia . SemiconductorAI Read

2 DigiTimes Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron forge rare alliance to pave way for unmanned chip fabs Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron are reportedly collaborating on charging standards for mobile robots used in semiconductor fabs, seeking to accelerate factory automation and lay the groundwork for unmanned manufacturing. The initiative is unusual as it brought together major industry rivals to standardise robo SemiconductorElectronicsAutomation Read
